name: Suzhou Xinguangyi Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Xinguangyi Electronics Co., Ltd. researches, develops, produces, and sells electronic thin film materials and application solutions in China. It offers a range of functional adhesive films, including anti-spill adhesive special films, high-resistance special membranes, new energy materials, modified materials, optical films, acoustic membranes, and other specialized membrane products. The company also provides related electronic thin film products and support services. Suzhou Xinguangyi Electronics Co., Ltd. was founded in 2004 and is based in Suzhou, China.
